scope: Actual-dashboard IMU software correction removal; source only, not deployed by this change

behavior.driver: unchanged BNO085 native fusion, SI units, raw validity and covariance contract
behavior.relay: /imu/data is an unmodified complete /imu/data_raw message; same header/frame/stamp/quaternion/vectors/all covariance entries
behavior.live_ui: sensor-native raw only; no manual-zero control; unavailable measurement groups remain unavailable
behavior.retired_api: POST /api/imu/zero and POST /imu/zero return HTTP410 with no sensor/state/settings writes
behavior.new_archives: processing.mode=sensor_native_raw; raw sample and availability preserved; corrected=null; no imu_calibration.json
behavior.old_archives: original files unchanged; previously recorded corrected samples and provenance still render as recorded

linux.command: source /opt/ros/iron/setup.bash && python3 -B -m unittest tests.test_imu_processing tests.test_imu_ws_bridge tests.test_imu_ros2_driver tests.test_imu_covariance_contract tests.test_data_recorder_service tests.test_imu_raw_api tests.test_raw_runtime tests.test_gps_recording tests.test_motor_recording.MotorArchiveApiTests tests.test_motor_recording.MotorRecorderTests tests.test_api -v
linux.isolation: network none, ipc private, read-only root and source, drop ALL capabilities, no-new-privileges, 1 CPU, 1 GiB, no devices or Docker socket, ROS_DOMAIN_ID=173; private tmpfs /tmp and /app/runtime

windows.command: python -B -m unittest tests.test_imu_processing tests.test_imu_ws_bridge tests.test_imu_ros2_driver tests.test_raw_runtime -v
windows.limitation: Existing app/telemetry require Linux fcntl; API/ROS wire tests run in isolated Linux, not native Windows

tests.preserved_attempts: linux-001 failed only because motor playback cache needed writable private tmpfs; linux-002 focused37 passed; first half-turn fixture accidentally retained ROS default w=1 and was corrected to explicit w=0; native Windows API import attempt hit existing fcntl limitation

web_image_without_recorder.isolation: network none, IPC private, read-only source/root, no devices/socket, /app/scripts masked by empty tmpfs; private /tmp and /app/runtime
web_image_without_recorder.note: After67-test pass, optional test import also accepts absent scripts or scripts.data_recorder_service, matching the real web-image layout; runtime source and ROS test behavior unchanged.

deployment_migration.note: Review external Compose command overrides before recreation; do not reuse retired flags. Existing archives/settings are not migration targets.

limits: No hardware access, live deployment, recording or motion performed by this implementation/test task
IMU-to-base mount axes remain unverified; raw data is not a calibrated base_link estimate
No static source quality, navigation authority, pose accuracy or zero-noise uncertainty claim
